name: A Hooked button is saved as Hookshot (#5469)
contract: A Hookshot (chain -800360) that hits a bleeding enemy runs spell_ascension_hookshot::Latch (AscensionRangerHookshot.cpp:41), which applies the 5 s ready aura 803857, learns Hooked 803852 as a temporary spell (learnSpell(Hooked, true), line 56) and replaces the cast Hookshot rank with it through SetTemporarySpellReplacement (line 57). A temporary spell is never written to character_spell, and Player::_LoadActions runs before another Hookshot lands, so a saved Hooked button would be refused and deleted at login. A creature casts Rend 772 to make the target bleed. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the spell id _SaveActions writes: a button holding Hooked must be saved as Hookshot 800360, and a button holding Hookshot itself is saved unchanged. The bleed comes from a Stormwind-faction (12) fixture casting Rend 772 on an Orgrimmar-faction (2) target, which the Alliance Ranger can also attack; two faction-7 creatures cannot attack each other (SPELL_FAILED_BAD_TARGETS).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The hook replaces Hookshot with Hooked
The Hooked button is saved as Hookshot
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
